native_state_model.forward_blend_cu: walks splats front-to-back per pixel; writes bucket_buffers.color_transmittance = float4[nbuckets*256] = (color_after.rgb, T) at each 32-splat bucket boundary; also final_transmittance[nbuckets*256], n_processed[nbuckets*256], max_n_processed[nbuckets]
native_state_model.backward_blend_backward_cu: one block per bucket (32 threads=lanes); each lane owns one splat; for each pixel warp-shuffles the running (transmittance, color_pixel_after, grad_color_pixel, grad_alpha_common) from lane i-1 to i (shfl_up), reconstructing per-splat state by REPLAYING the compositing recurrence within the 32-splat bucket from the checkpoint; leader (lane0) loads checkpoint from shared memory
per_splat_backward_state_recovered: color_pixel_after (color from k onward, excl k)
